title: maxArraySize=1 does not shorten the array, it turns it into an object
rationale: The degenerate lower bound, which the Builder explicitly permits. Truncating to one element pushes the serialized value below the size>1 detection gate, so the array is no longer recognised as an array. The bound leaks out of the size domain and into the type domain.
catchesBugClass: The size>1 heuristic - a detection rule correct for the common case and wrong at the boundary. Also catches any resource bound that leaks into type inference.
cannotCatch: It cannot isolate WHICH of the two mechanisms to blame: truncation is correct and detection is wrong, but the fixture fails as a unit.

predicted.detail: An array of three objects comes back as an object with string fields: element type, container type and value type all wrong. Set maxArraySize to 2 and the same document returns a proper array - two configurations of one bound, two different reconstructed schemas.
